compatibility: Integer is supported; minimum and maximum are rejected by the pinned converter. These Tools intentionally retain number limits with default 20 and floor/clamp (list 1–100, read 1–200); no fractional/out-of-range compatibility removal.
fixture: Two fresh isolated Profiles; same synthetic Bot and Group names. Production Human bridge commits four Group records in joined Teams and one private record; creator/member IDs and message IDs are generated per Profile. A real model follows list/history/joined cursors and probes required failures. Search bounds end before the QA prompt so DM instructions cannot match seed records.
